prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose a pet personality that will keep you company while you work.", "Select Companion"]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Your pet is getting ready for your desktop!", "Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Right-click your tray icon anytime to wake, hide, or play with your pet.", "Got It!"]
2: ["Upload & Verify Your Custom Pet Photo", "We analyze your image to make sure lighting and resolution produce a clear desktop pet.", "Upload Photo", "Quality Checker Active"]
3: ["How Would You Like to Begin?", "Pick a ready-made companion or build your own custom pet from scratch."]
4: ["Use the same email to keep your saved pets synced across devices and sessions."]
5: ["Choose Your Pet Experience", "Select standard adoption or custom companion generation to start."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your pet companion is officially registered.", "Official Pet Guardian Certified"]
7: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Launch", "Setting up desktop collision boundaries and sprite animations..."]
8: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look for your companion roaming your screen. Right-click its icon in your system tray anytime to feed, chat, or minimize.", "Pro-tip: Double-click the tray icon to pull your pet directly to your active window."]
9: ["Desktop Pet Tips"]
